title: File:Black Canyon National Recreation Trail near Black Canyon City (52633831475).jpg
claims: The image shows a tall multi-armed saguaro in the foreground, with a dry wash, green desert scrub, rocky slopes and a broad Sonoran Desert canyon behind it.

The Commons description places the photograph along the Black Canyon National Recreation Trail near Black Canyon City, Arizona, and credits Chris Wonderly / Bureau of Land Management Arizona; it is a trail-corridor landscape, not a race-day photograph, and shows no course flag, aid table or runner.
The author is BLMArizona; the file is public domain; the photograph was taken on 2023-01-14 at 10:45:54; the original is 4,032 x 3,024 pixels and 5,103,865 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 267,858 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits BLM Arizona / Chris Wonderly, public domain, Wikimedia Commons.
